title: Green Christmas Toile Digital Paper
author: Paper & Pattern Studio
description:
Bring timeless holiday charm to your creative projects with this Green Christmas Toile Digital Paper Pack. Featuring 8 seamless 12×12 designs in traditional red and green, this vintage-inspired collection blends old-world elegance with festive warmth. Perfect for scrapbooking, junk journals, card making, sublimation, and more.
✦ What You’ll Get:
 • 8 seamless digital papers (JPG format)
 • Size: 12″ x 12″
 • High resolution: 300 dpi
 • Instant download — no physical item will be shipped
 • Commercial Use Included (see below)
✦ Use These Designs For:

✦ How to Access your file:
After purchase, you’ll be able to download the file.
✦ Not Allowed:

 • Offer them as freebies
✦ Need Help?
 Due to the nature of digital products, refunds aren’t available. But if you run into any issues, I’m here to help!
